vocabulary.definition: a planet that orbits a star outside the solar system
vocabulary.example: Scientists discovered an exoplanet that may have conditions suitable for life.

vocabulary.definition: driven or moved forward by a physical force
vocabulary.example: The spaceship was propelled by powerful rocket engines.

vocabulary.definition: having the ability to operate independently without human intervention
vocabulary.example: The drone flew autonomously using its advanced navigation system.

vocabulary.definition: to establish a colony or settlements in a new area
vocabulary.example: Historically, many European powers sought to colonize territories around the world.

vocabulary.definition: the natural environment in which an organism or species lives
vocabulary.example: Polar bears rely on sea ice as their habitat for hunting seals.

vocabulary.definition: people who are trained to travel in space
vocabulary.example: The astronauts aboard the International Space Station conduct experiments in microgravity.
